inspected_findings.shapes: B=1 default; trajectories[B,G,T,N,256], ID256 concatenated ->512; vocabulary50+unmatched; TA6layers8heads; DanceTrackT30/interval4, BFTT20. Temporal_Adapter squeezes batch0 and assumes B1.
inspected_findings.temporal: TAcausal lower triangular plus missing-frame mask; IDdecoder rejects memorytime>=querytime. Current runtime embeds detections before history update.
inspected_findings.loss: Detector CE/bbox/GIoU/depth/contrastive plus masked ID CE or focal; contrastive quality weighting source trace pending.
inspected_findings.license: Top-level MIT copyright2025YuqingShao; inherited MOTIP/DeformableDETR/TrackEval notices and depth/weight licenses still separate.
inspected_findings.pretrained: COCO DeformableDETR/MOTIP release paths, dataset-specific adapted weights; depthmaps generated externally by VideoDepthAnything. No new pretrained downloads.
inspected_findings.dependency: README Python3.12; torch2.4.0/torchvision0.19.0; compiled models/ops multi-scale deformable attention and accelerate. Existing torch2.0 environment is not declared fully compatible.
inspected_findings.compatibility: Full detector/depth/trajectory system differs from fixedV3 RGB512 proposal encoder; independently adapt temporal/identity refinement only after matched controls. Depth is not an IR substitute or free online precomputed input.
inspected_findings.novelty_overlap: Explicit spatial/temporal/identity refinement and instance contrastive objectives overlap broad evidence-learning claim. Mere adapter naming is not novel.

inspected_findings.paper: DINOv2: Learning Robust Visual Features without Supervision; primary arXiv2304.07193, submitted2023/revised2024. General image/pixel features, not individual fish labels.
inspected_findings.license: Apache2 code LICENSE and MODEL_CARD explicit model license; official ViTS14 public pretrained URL found. Live HEAD attempt failed TLS, no weights acquired.
inspected_findings.training: dinov2/train/train.py main; SSLMetaArch.forward_backward student global2/local8 views, teacher no-grad and EMA; defaultsharded-infinite sampler, no fishID PK/hard-frame sampling.
inspected_findings.inference: hub/backbones.py dinov2_vits14 and vision_transformer.forward_features normalized CLS/register/patch dictionary. Single current crop, no temporal future input.
inspected_findings.shape: Small14: dim384,12blocks,6heads; patch_embed asserts H/W multiples14. Raw128x256 fails direct source contract despite model-card truncation wording. Use declared resize/pad, e.g126x252 ->162spatial patches. NonregisterS14 hasCLS+162, registervariant adds4.
inspected_findings.loss: DINO teacher-distribution CE for other global/current local views; iBOT teacher-stopped masked patch CE with inverse mask-count weighting; KoLeo normalized batch nearest-neighbor negative-log distance excludes self and same-image otherglobal view by cropchunk. No physical-ID positives/negatives or cross-frame association loss.
inspected_findings.pretrained: ViTS14 distilled from pretrainedViTg; LVD142M curated142Mimages. Exact fishdataset overlap cannot be verified from private corpus; do not claim zero external overlap.
inspected_findings.dependency: torch2.0/torchvision0.15/xformers0.0.18 official requirements; SSLMetaArch raises ifxformers missing, FSDP/AMP/CUDA distributed training. Inference fallback and current environment execution still untested.
inspected_findings.compatibility: Current-only RGB backbone fits frozen-global/local crop controls, new384dimension coordinate must create matched producer and exclude outer/inner videos for learned fish adapters. Old512GRU cannot be reused across latent spaces.
inspected_findings.port: Use frozenCLS/patchTokens as A1/A2 controls, then independent supervised fish adapters/local pooling. Do not repeat142M-pretraining or download giant/register/depthheads unnecessarily.
inspected_findings.novelty_overlap: Teacher EMA, patchdistillation and localtoken features are prior mechanisms; merely adoptingDINOpatches or EMAis not new identity prediction.
inspected_findings.remaining: Verify actual lawful small-weight delivery and executable inference/preprocessing route; task-level full semantic audit not yet marked complete.
